title: Model picker
description: Language model picker in the chat input toolbar: a split button, model name + configuration. With `model` (Agents window layout) it shows the provider icon, the model name and its configuration summary ("Medium · 272K"); the name opens the model list and the summary opens the model's details (effort, context size, speed, pricing). Choosing a model or configuration updates it and fires `change` / `configure`.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Model name (default "Models"); derived from `model` when set

attributes.name: model
attributes.description: Model id from ds.chatPickers (e.g. claude-opus-5-5): shows its provider icon, name and effort · context summary, and opens the real model list

attributes.name: notice
attributes.description: Show the mid-session prompt-cache notice in the list

states.name: compact
states.description: icon + configuration summary, then icon only (compact-picker; .model-picker-split.compact / .icon-only.minimal); its minimum width is the name (≤ 90px) + summary. Set by the composer's responsive pass; CSS from source (not captured).
states.trigger: the composer runs out of room
